predecessors.name: Byzantine Empire
predecessors.text: Valona, with Kanina and Berat as the main fortresses: 'roughly encompassing the territories of the modern counties of Vlorë (Valona), Fier, and Berat'

successors.name: Ottoman Empire
successors.text: the Principality of Valona as the Sanjak of Avlona, then confined to the area around Vlorë

rulers.name: Balsha II
rulers.title: Lord of Kanina and Valona, later Duke of Albania

ledger.x: 1346: Dušan's vassal John Komnenos Asen takes Valona.
1372: the house of Balsha takes Valona.
By 1372: Berat passes to the Muzaka.
1396: Mrkša Žarković becomes lord of Valona and Kanina (1396-1414); Italian sources call him 'King of Serbia'.
1414: Rugjina Balsha rules the principality (1414-1417), the last ruler.

wars.name: Serbian conquest of Valona
wars.outcome: Dušan took Albania during the Byzantine civil war; Valona fell in late 1345 or early 1346 and John Komnenos Asen was put in charge (some scholars: Valona and Kanina already in 1337).

wars.name: Ottoman conquest of Valona
wars.outcome: The Ottomans took the city in 1417; Venice's attempts to recover or buy the territory came to nothing.

certainty.note: The page names the extent as counties and gives no boundaries; the shape is the three counties (1346-1371) and Vlorë county (1372-1417), read from the gazetteer, not a surveyed line.
